newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX backs off year high on Slovnaft losses.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX backs off year high on Slovnaft losses.

text.p: Losses to shares of oil refiner Slovnaft pulled the Slovak SAX index down 1.11 points to 204.05 points listless trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Monday.
Slovnaft edged down 10 crowns to 990, a development dealers said the rest of the market was mirroring, mainly as a result of the general downtrend at market across the region.
"Our market was more or less unaffected by neighbouring markets in the last weeks," Peter Krutil of Creditanstalt said. "Now the general decrease hit also the BSE."
Krutil said he doubted Slovnaft would break through 1,000 crown-level in the coming days due to strong sell offers at 1,000 and more.

Steel maker VSZ closed up five crowns at 715, with 10,310 traded shares, but Krutil said the share would decrease soon. "I would say relatively succesful trading (on Monday) in VSZ might be only the last stage before it hits a declining phase," he said.
Overall volume fell to 149,690 shares, from 515,710 shares traded on Friday, while turnover decreased to 97.5 million crowns, from 670.11 million.
